item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
• The interface is now in all 25 languages the model recognises: new are Swedish, Hungarian, Danish, Estonian, Lithuanian, Latvian, Slovenian, Russian, Ukrainian, Greek and Maltese, machine-translated. About Pegel says so and links to a form for reporting mistakes.
  • macOS has no Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian or Maltese interface. To use Pegel in one of them, add the language to the preferred languages or choose it for Pegel alone under Language & Region › Applications.
  • Greek dictation: the speech model has no final sigma and wrote "<unk>" in its place. Pegel now puts ς there.
  • The name in the About and setup windows is set in PT Sans, the typeface of the website.

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
• The interface is now also in Portuguese, Polish, Dutch, Slovak, Czech, Romanian, Croatian, Bulgarian and Finnish, machine-translated. About Pegel says so and links to a form for reporting mistakes.
  • macOS has no Bulgarian interface. To use Pegel in Bulgarian, add Bulgarian to the preferred languages or choose it for Pegel alone under Language & Region › Applications.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
• Transcribe video files too: MP4, MOV and other films, Pegel reads their sound track. The menu item is now "Transcribe Audio or Video File…".
  • The interface is now also in French, Spanish and Italian, machine-translated. About Pegel says so and links to a form for reporting mistakes.
  • The About window is taller, so the licences are no longer cut off.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
• Volume control for the start and stop tones.
  • Updates can now install automatically; a second switch in About Pegel.
  • On macOS 26 and later, Pegel now uses the current system design.
  • Percentages and milliseconds follow your region's number format.
  • Dictating in Bulgarian, Russian, Ukrainian or Greek no longer turns the text into Latin letters when that language is among your system languages.
  • Fixed: a space was inserted at the start of empty fields in VS Code, Slack and other Chromium-based apps.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
• Quiet start and stop tones, five sets to choose from or off, with a preview in the settings.
  • Colour palettes shown as round swatches with their name.
  • Fixed: releasing Command a moment before the key sometimes inserted only "^" instead of the dictation.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description: • The licence texts now open in their own window.

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
• Transcribe an audio file from the menu; the text goes to the clipboard.
  • The pill follows the caret's screen and remembers a position per screen.
  • Fixed microphone choice, six colour palettes, settings with a live preview.
  • Fixed: the first dictation after a pause sometimes recorded nothing.
